title: [EXA-5] DM reachability relies on "relay hints" in the recipient's DID document, which §2 forbids
description: Review finding EXA-5: DM reachability relies on "relay hints" in the recipient's DID document, which §2 forbids (lens EXA). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:151, 153. Fix: The contradiction with 02:37 and 02:302 is real. The reviewer's replacement text says DM traffic flows "under the CO's `RelayServiceAgreement`", but a DM group has no CO. 04:116 says "DM groups are not owned by any Space". Relays admit only envelopes on a chain registered by a CO registration service (05:203, 10:612), and every announcement needs `billingSig` (05:204). Nothing in spec/ or ARCHITECTURE says who registers and countersigns a DM group's access chain. Delete the relay-hint text either way, and also fix `did:web:agency.example` (EXA-4). Full text: notes/review/EXA-verified.md and notes/review/EXA.md.
